SaintapediaSuggestMode.description: 'public' (anon-friendly, captcha on by default, short form) or 'enterprise' (relaxed limits, captcha off by default, email field on).

SaintapediaSuggestNamespaces.description: Namespaces where the widget is shown and the API accepts submissions. Default: main namespace only.

SaintapediaSuggestTables.description: Allow-list of Cargo tables and fields readers may target. Map of table name => list of field names, or table name => '*' for every non-underscore field in that table's schema. Empty map = feature effectively off (no field is suggestable).

SaintapediaSuggestMaxFields.description: Hard cap on how many (table, field) pairs are exposed to one page's widget, so a wide allow-list cannot bloat every page's HTML.

SaintapediaSuggestMaxValueLength.description: Max characters accepted for a suggested value (and stored for the current-value snapshot).

SaintapediaSuggestRateLimit.description: Max suggestions per IP per day in public mode.

SaintapediaSuggestEnterpriseRateLimit.description: Max suggestions per IP per day in enterprise mode.

SaintapediaSuggestEnableEmail.description: Show the optional contact email field (automatically enabled in enterprise mode).

SaintapediaSuggestRequireCaptcha.description: Require hCaptcha via ConfirmEdit. null = auto (true for public mode, false for enterprise). true/false overrides per wiki.

SaintapediaSuggestNotifyUsers.description: Usernames (who can manage suggestions) receiving Echo alerts on each new suggestion. Empty = none. Requires Extension:Echo.

SaintapediaSuggestNotifyWatchers.description: When true and Echo is loaded, also notify watchers of the article who may manage suggestions. Never notifies users who cannot open the dashboard.

SaintapediaSuggestNotifyEmail.description: Optional single email address notified on each new suggestion (requires $wgEnableEmail). false disables.

SaintapediaSuggestAccessPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page (DB key without prefix) listing groups allowed to manage suggestions. Missing/empty page falls back to AccessGroups.

SaintapediaSuggestAccessGroups.description: Default groups when the access page is missing or empty. Default sysop (safe for public wikis).

SaintapediaSuggestEmailAccessPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page listing groups allowed to see the optional contact-email field. Separate from dashboard access.

SaintapediaSuggestEmailAccessGroups.description: Default groups allowed to see the contact-email field when the email access page is missing or empty.

SaintapediaSuggestExportAccessPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page listing groups allowed to download the JSON export. Separate from dashboard access.

SaintapediaSuggestExportAccessGroups.description: Default groups allowed to export when the export access page is missing or empty.

SaintapediaSuggestRateLimitPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page holding a single integer overriding the mode-appropriate rate limit without a deploy.

SaintapediaSuggestNotifyUsersPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page, one username per line, overriding SaintapediaSuggestNotifyUsers without a deploy.

SaintapediaSuggestRequireCaptchaPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page holding true/false overriding SaintapediaSuggestRequireCaptcha. Security-sensitive: editable by anyone with editinterface.

SaintapediaSuggestEnabledPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page holding true/false to switch the reader widget off wiki-wide without a deploy. Missing/empty page falls back to SaintapediaSuggestEnabled.

SaintapediaSuggestEnabled.description: Master switch for the reader-facing widget. The dashboard stays reachable when this is false.

SaintapediaSuggestWebhook.description: HTTPS URL that receives POST JSON {count,items} of pending suggestions from maintenance/ProcessSuggestions.php. Empty disables the script unless --webhook is passed. HTTP is refused.

SaintapediaSuggestWebhookToken.description: Optional Bearer token sent as Authorization when posting the batch. Keep in LocalSettings / env, never on a wiki page.

SaintapediaSuggestBatchSize.description: Default number of pending suggestions posted per ProcessSuggestions.php run (max 500).

SaintapediaSuggestMergeDuplicates.description: Fold repeat reports of the same value for the same field into one queue item, counted on the canonical row. Set false to keep every submission as its own dashboard entry.

SaintapediaSuggestRowLabelField.description: Map of Cargo table name => field whose value names each row in the picker, for tables where a page stores several rows. Unset tables fall back to the first allow-listed field that has a value, then to "Row N".

SaintapediaSuggestMaxRowsPerTable.description: Cap on how many rows of one Cargo table are offered for a single page, so a page with hundreds of rows cannot inflate the widget.
